summary.en: Agnes AI international with Chrome browser sign-in: live OpenAI-compatible text models, Token Plan and Agent Plan usage, and the USD wallet balance.
summary.zh: 通过 Chrome 浏览器登录 Agnes AI 国际版：动态发现 OpenAI 兼容文本模型，显示 Token Plan、Agent Plan 用量与美元余额，无需手动复制会话 token。

summary.en: Recall from your PowerContext service and optionally save complete conversations. Configure the service URL first; capture is off by default.
summary.zh: 从自己的 PowerContext 服务召回记忆，并按需存回完整对话。先配置服务地址；对话存回默认关闭。

summary.en: Give every harness behind Magpie Nowledge Mem automatically: recall and the Context Bundle (or Working Memory) before each request, per-harness provenance, optional import of completed conversations as Mem Threads, and a real connection test in the page. A local or remote Mem; saving conversations is off by default.
summary.zh: 让 Magpie 后面的每个 harness 自动接入 Nowledge Mem：每次请求前召回记忆与 Context Bundle（缺失时用 Working Memory），记录来自哪个 harness，按需把已完成的对话导入为 Mem Thread，并在页面中提供真实的连接测试。本机或远端 Mem 都可用；对话导入默认关闭。

summary.en: Long-term memory from your own Aelios on Cloudflare: recall before each turn for every agent behind magpie, and optionally record the conversation so Aelios can learn it. Set it up on the plugin's own page, with a connection test and per-model or per-agent routing to separate assistants. Recording is off by default.
summary.zh: 接入你自己部署在 Cloudflare 上的 Aelios 长期记忆：magpie 后面的每个 agent 每轮自动召回，按需把对话交给 Aelios 记住。在插件自己的页面里配置，可选择连接测试，并按模型或客户端分流到不同的助手。记录默认关闭。

summary.en: Help AI agents evolve through experience: per-turn recall and complete engine-policy reads, automatic process diaries and grounded archival with write readback. Configure an existing local Runtime and generation model first. Archival defaults on; raw capture off. Background storage happens after reply completion.
summary.zh: 让 AI Agent 通过经验积累持续自进化：每轮召回并读完整政策，自动保存过程日记与整理长期记忆，写后回读。先配置已有本地 Runtime 和生成模型；归档默认开启，原始采集关闭。宿主限制下存储在回复完成后执行。

summary.en: GitHub Copilot on GitHub.com or GitHub Enterprise, with premium request or credit usage, remaining allowance and quota reset dates.
summary.zh: GitHub Copilot：支持 GitHub.com 与 GitHub Enterprise，显示高级请求或积分用量、剩余额度和重置时间。

summary.en: Unofficial JoyCode provider: JD account browser sign-in, live models and credit multipliers, plan credits and streaming tool calls.
summary.zh: 非官方 JoyCode 插件：京东账号浏览器登录，动态模型与积分倍率、套餐额度及流式工具调用。

summary.en: Kimi desktop Work subscription through its local sign-in, with live Work models and shared membership usage. Separate from Kimi Code.
summary.zh: 使用本机普通 Kimi 桌面版的 Work 登录，自动读取 Work 模型和会员共享用量；独立于 Kimi Code。

summary.en: OpenCode Zen's free models with the public credential, automatic discovery and native streaming protocols.
summary.zh: 使用 public 凭证接入 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，自动发现模型并支持原生流式协议。

summary.en: Z.ai and BigModel GLM Coding Plan, team seats and ZCode's free Start Plan, with a daily claim of its gift plans.
summary.zh: Z.ai 与智谱 GLM Coding Plan，支持团队席位和 ZCode 免费 Start Plan，可每日领取 ZCode 活动包。

summary.en: Your Qoder subscription: international (qoder.com) or Qoder CN, the China site (qoder.cn, Alibaba Cloud or phone sign-in), each its own provider. Also QwenWork (千问办公): the public cloud or the enterprise flagship with its own domain. Unofficial for QwenWork.
summary.zh: 用 Qoder 自己的设备登录使用 Qoder 订阅：国际版（qoder.com）与 Qoder 中国版（Qoder CN，qoder.cn，阿里云账号 / 手机号登录）各是一个订阅；也接入千问办公：公有云与企业旗舰版（输入企业自己的域名）。千问办公部分非官方。

summary.en: Devin's models with your Devin account — a browser sign-in or the devin CLI's.
summary.zh: 用 Devin 账号使用 Devin 的模型：浏览器登录，或沿用 devin CLI 的登录。

summary.en: Claude, GPT, Gemini and Grok hosted by Zed, on your Zed plan.
summary.zh: 用 Zed 订阅使用 Zed 托管的 Claude、GPT、Gemini 和 Grok。

summary.en: Factory's Droid subscription: 30 models from Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI and open labs.
summary.zh: Factory Droid 订阅：Anthropic、OpenAI、xAI 及开源模型共 30 个。

summary.en: SuperGrok and X Premium+, through the Grok Build CLI's sign-in.
summary.zh: 通过 Grok Build CLI 的登录使用 SuperGrok 和 X Premium+。

summary.en: Command Code plans — Pro, GOAT, Max, Ultra, Go and Teams.
summary.zh: Command Code 各档套餐：Pro、GOAT、Max、Ultra、Go 和 Teams。

summary.en: Xiaomi MiMo models with your Xiaomi account.
summary.zh: 用小米账号使用小米 MiMo 模型。

summary.en: Cursor Pro, Pro+, Ultra and Teams — every model your plan has, with tool calls.
summary.zh: Cursor Pro、Pro+、Ultra 与 Teams：套餐里的所有模型，支持工具调用。

summary.en: Kiro Free, Pro, Pro+ and Power — Kiro's sign-in, kiro-cli's, or an API key.
summary.zh: Kiro Free、Pro、Pro+ 与 Power：Kiro 登录、沿用 kiro-cli 的登录，或 API key。

summary.en: MiniMax Code credits and M Plan with device sign-in, native web search, image/video generation and media tools through Magpie MCP.
summary.zh: MiniMax Code 积分与 M Plan、设备登录，提供原生网络搜索、生图、生视频及多模态 MCP 工具。

summary.en: WorkBuddy's China build (CodeBuddy plan) and its international build.
summary.zh: WorkBuddy 国内版（CodeBuddy 套餐）与国际版。

summary.en: Cline's models on your own Cline account — usage billing, ClinePass and Cline's free models — with Cline's device sign-in or an API key.
summary.zh: 用自己的 Cline 账号使用 Cline 的模型——用量计费、ClinePass 与免费模型——支持 Cline 设备登录或 API key。

summary.en: Trae CN (trae.cn) and Trae international (trae.ai) models with your own account, free tier included — Trae's own browser sign-in. Experimental.
summary.zh: 用 Trae CN（trae.cn）与 Trae 国际版（trae.ai）账号使用各自的模型，含免费版，使用 Trae 自己的浏览器登录。实验性。

summary.en: Open Design Cloud's Design Plan (open-design.ai): the account's device sign-in, the models the plan entitles it to, and the plan's 5-hour and 7-day allowance and wallet balance.
summary.zh: Open Design Cloud 的 Design Plan（open-design.ai）：账号设备登录、套餐可用的模型，以及 5 小时与 7 天额度、钱包余额。

summary.en: Meituan's 妙手 CatPaw (ai.catpaw.meituan.com): a browser web sign-in or the desktop client's saved credentials, chat through its round/event/turn conversation protocol, models and credit balance.
summary.zh: 美团妙手 CatPaw（ai.catpaw.meituan.com）：浏览器网页登录或妙手桌面端已保存的登录态，经其 round/event/turn 会话协议对话，含模型与积分余额。

summary.en: iFlytek's Loomy (loomyad.xunfei.cn): SMS sign-in, OpenAI-compatible chat with reasoning-effort folding and image markers, the live model catalog, two point wallets and the daily first-login grant.
summary.zh: 讯飞 Loomy（loomyad.xunfei.cn）：短信验证码登录，OpenAI 兼容对话（思考档折叠与图片标记适配），实时模型目录、双积分钱包与每日首登赠送。

summary.en: Nous Portal models, with Nous Portal's device sign-in.
summary.zh: 通过 Nous Portal 自己的设备码登录使用 Nous Portal 模型。

summary.en: SenseTime Raccoon (xiaohuanxiong.com) models, account credits and daily check-in, with browser sign-in or Raccoon desktop's live sign-in.
summary.zh: 商汤小浣熊（xiaohuanxiong.com）模型、积分余额与每日签到，支持浏览器登录或直接复用小浣熊桌面端登录态。

summary.en: SenseNova (SenseTime 日日新) Token Plan: one console sign-in reads the credit pools, their 5-hour and 7-day windows and the expiring grants, and — with an API key pasted at sign-in — serves the plan's own models for chat.
summary.zh: 商汤日日新 Token Plan：一次控制台登录即可读取积分池、5 小时 / 7 天窗口与将过期的返赠余额；登录时粘贴 API Key，同一个账号就能直接调用计划内模型对话。

summary.en: AutoClaw (Zhipu OpenClaw) cloud accounts: oversea web sign-in (Google/z.ai) or CN phone SMS, credit balance and daily check-in.
summary.zh: AutoClaw（智谱澳龙/OpenClaw）云端账号：国际版网页登录（Google/z.ai）或国内手机验证码，积分余额与每日签到。

summary.en: Unofficial: Huawei Cloud CodeArts (码道) coding plans and OfficeAce (AgentArts), each signed in with Huawei Cloud OAuth on its own card — GLM, DeepSeek, openPangu and OfficeAce's MaaS models, live models and credit rates, credit usage by bucket and the daily check-in. Replaces officeace-auth; accounts signed in there keep working.
summary.zh: 非官方：华为云码道（CodeArts）编码套餐与 OfficeAce（AgentArts），两张卡各自用华为云 OAuth 登录；GLM、DeepSeek、openPangu 与 OfficeAce 的 MaaS 模型，实时模型与积分倍率、分桶积分用量和每日签到。取代 officeace-auth，原已登录的账号继续可用。

summary.en: Vertex AI models and Google Cloud promotional credits, signed with your own gcloud or ADC login. Lists only the models your project can call.
summary.zh: 用本机 gcloud / ADC 登录使用 Vertex AI 模型，并读取 Google Cloud 促销赠金；只列出项目实际能调用的模型。

summary.en: New API's parameter override: set, delete, move or rewrite fields of every request, by model or by condition.
summary.zh: New API 的参数覆盖：按模型或条件设置、删除、移动或改写每个请求的字段。

summary.en: New API's model redirection: send a model under another name, by name or pattern; replies keep the name asked for.
summary.zh: New API 的模型重定向：按名称或正则把模型换成另一个发出，回复里仍是原来的名字。

summary.en: Add your own system prompt to every request, or only some agents' or models', in each API's own place.
summary.zh: 给每个请求（或指定 agent、模型）加上自己的系统提示词，放在各 API 自己的位置。

summary.en: New API's sensitive-word filter: turn away or mask words and patterns in what you send, and in replies.
summary.zh: New API 的敏感词过滤：拒绝或替换你发出的内容和回复里的词与正则。

summary.en: Take a model's <think>…</think> out of its reply's text, or put a Chat reply's reasoning into it.
summary.zh: 去掉回复正文开头的 <think>…</think>，或把 Chat 回复的思考内容放进正文。

summary.en: Kilo Code (kilo.ai) on magpie's Agents page: pick one of magpie's models for it, and switch it off to put its config back.
summary.zh: 把 Kilo Code（kilo.ai）加到 magpie 的 Agent 页：选择 magpie 的模型，关掉即恢复原来的配置。

summary.en: Claude Code and Claude Desktop on an Antigravity account: the words Antigravity refuses their system prompt for are broken up, in what Antigravity alone is sent.
summary.zh: 让 Claude Code 和 Claude Desktop 能用 Antigravity 账号：只在发给 Antigravity 的请求里拆开它据以拒绝系统提示词的那几个词。

summary.en: Opt-in, per-provider Codex Responses history filtering after switching providers. Preserves readable content and tool-call pairing; no model probes.
summary.zh: 按供应商开关 Codex Responses 历史过滤，缓解切换上游后的密文和历史 ID 兼容问题；保留正文与工具配对，不运行模型检测。

summary.en: Send a request's history smaller: fold a run of blank lines, drop a system prompt written twice and a message repeated right after itself, and cut a past tool result longer than maxToolLength at a word boundary. The turn being sent now is left whole.
summary.zh: 把请求的历史发得更小：折叠连续空行、去掉逐字重复的 system 提示与紧挨着重复的消息、把历史中超过 maxToolLength 的工具结果在词边界处截断；正在发送的这一轮原样不动。

summary.en: Aider (aider.chat) on magpie's Agents page: pick one of magpie's models for it, and switch it off to put its config back.
summary.zh: 把 Aider（aider.chat）加到 magpie 的 Agent 页：给它选 magpie 的模型，关掉即恢复它原来的配置。

summary.en: PiG (Pi in Go): add Magpie's endpoint and model catalog, choose models in PiG, and keep startup settings unchanged.
summary.zh: 为 PiG（Pi in Go）注入 Magpie 端点与模型列表，在 PiG 内选择模型，保持启动设置不变。

summary.en: Bub (bub.build) on magpie's Agents page: pick one of magpie's models and Bub uses it, through ~/.bub/config.yml. Needs Bub 0.5.1 or later.
summary.zh: 把 Bub（bub.build）加到 magpie 的 Agent 页：给它选一个 magpie 的模型，通过 ~/.bub/config.yml 生效。需要 Bub 0.5.1 或更新版本。

summary.en: Type4Me (macOS voice input) on magpie's Agents page: pick one of magpie's models for its LLM post-processing, used from the next dictation.
summary.zh: 把 Type4Me（macOS 语音输入）加到 magpie 的 Agent 页：给它的 LLM 后处理选 magpie 的模型，下一次语音输入即生效。

summary.en: Tuanjie Cowork (codely) on magpie's Agents page: pick one of magpie's models and Cowork chats with it, on the subscriptions magpie already holds.
summary.zh: 把团结 Cowork（codely）加到 magpie 的 Agent 页：给它选一个 magpie 的模型，它聊天就走那个模型，用的是 magpie 里已登录的那些订阅的额度。

summary.en: Open Code Review (Alibaba's ocr CLI) on magpie's Agents page: pick one of magpie's models and ocr review / ocr scan use it, read from the config on the next run.
summary.zh: 把 Open Code Review（阿里巴巴的 ocr CLI）加到 magpie 的 Agent 页：给它选 magpie 的模型，下一次 ocr review / ocr scan 即从配置中读到并生效。

summary.en: An explicit seed copies Magpie's full model catalog into Junie CLI and uses Magpie's selected model as the launch default, without LiteLLM. Native ECO is unavailable for custom profiles in Junie 3893.6.
summary.zh: 手动 seed 向 Junie CLI 同步全部模型，并将 Magpie 所选模型设为启动默认模型，无需 LiteLLM。Junie 3893.6 的自定义 profile 不支持原生 ECO。

summary.en: Two routings that keep something in reserve: fill accounts up to a ceiling of their allowance, or use subscriptions before API keys.
summary.zh: 两种留余量的路由：账号用到额度上限就换下一个，或订阅账号优先于 API key。

summary.en: Search1API web search, news, agentic search, page retrieval, sitemaps and trends through Magpie's tools MCP server. Sign in with OAuth or an API key.
summary.zh: 通过 Magpie 的工具 MCP 服务使用 Search1API 网页搜索、新闻、智能搜索、页面读取、站点链接和趋势；支持 OAuth 或 API key 登录。

summary.en: Exact arithmetic, unit conversion and calendar date math as tools for every agent: no network, no key.
summary.zh: 给每个 agent 的精确计算、单位换算和日历日期计算工具：不联网，不需要 key。

summary.en: LayerFS workspaces for every agent: deduplicated checkpoints and branches behind stable filesystem paths, instead of a fresh copy of the tree for every agent.
summary.zh: 给每个 agent 的 LayerFS 工作区：稳定的文件系统路径背后是可去重的检查点与分支，而不是每个 agent 各复制一棵项目树。

summary.en: A page in magpie's window with calls, errors, tokens and cost for today, 7 or 30 days, and the models behind them. Reads only your usage summary.
summary.zh: 在 magpie 窗口里一眼看到今天、7 天或 30 天的调用、错误、token、费用和对应模型。只读取用量汇总。

summary.en: Check for suspected model substitution by comparing response fingerprints across Magpie providers. Uses lm-detector with shared challenges, local evidence history and JSON export; sampling uses provider quota. Reference data is downloaded on demand from lm.ikale.io, falling back to cdn.jsdmirror.com.
summary.zh: 在 Magpie 内检测响应指纹，为疑似模型替换提供核查线索。基于 lm-detector，支持跨渠道共享挑战、保留本地证据与 JSON 导出；采样会消耗模型额度。参考库按需从 lm.ikale.io 下载，备用源为 cdn.jsdmirror.com。

summary.en: A chat page in magpie's window by Magic_zero: talk to magpie's own models with your MCP servers, instructions and skills, images and LaTeX. Runs a local service on 127.0.0.1 that only its own page can use.
summary.zh: Magic_zero 做的 magpie 窗口内「对话」页面：用 magpie 自己的模型聊天，带上你的 MCP 服务器、指令和技能，支持图片与 LaTeX。本地服务只在 127.0.0.1，只给自己的页面用。

summary.en: Reads the session files of Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Kimi Code, DeepSeek Harness, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Pi, omp, Qoder, WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy and Grok Build on this computer (prompts, replies and tool commands; text can be turned off). Shows them in a real WebGL 3D office with eleven scenes, an isometric/2D office, or a grouped workbench with Today usage, recent conversations and approvals.
summary.zh: 读取本机 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot CLI、Kimi Code、DeepSeek Harness、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code、Pi、omp、Qoder、WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy、Grok Build 的会话文件（含提问、回复与工具命令，可关闭文本），用真 3D 办公室（十一种场景）、等距/2D 办公室或分组工作台展示，带今日用量、最近对话与批准状态。

summary.en: Kimi desktop Work on Magpie's Agents page: select a model from Magpie, then disconnect to restore the original service. Not Kimi Code CLI.
summary.zh: 把普通 Kimi 桌面版 Work 接入 Magpie Agent 页，使用已配置的模型；断开恢复原连接。不是 Kimi Code CLI。

summary.en: A push when an agent's turn is done or fails, after it ran long enough to be worth one: ntfy, Bark, Gotify, Server酱, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram or your own webhook. Agent, project, model and time only by default; the reply's text is opt-in.
summary.zh: agent 一轮任务跑完或失败时推送提醒（只提醒跑够设定时长的任务）：支持 ntfy、Bark、Gotify、Server酱、飞书、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 和自定义 webhook。默认只发 agent、项目、模型和用时，回复正文需手动开启。

summary.en: Email alerts when a provider call fails or a quota window runs out: your own SMTP account, your own words in the mail, and your own list of what to watch, with cooldowns and an hourly cap so a bad hour stays bounded — plus an optional periodic usage digest.
summary.zh: 供应商调用失败或额度窗口用尽时发邮件提醒：用你自己的 SMTP 账号、自己的邮件文案、自己勾选的监控事项；同类事件冷却合并，另有每小时上限，糟糕的一小时不会失控；另可开启定期用量摘要。

summary.en: Cloudflare Workers AI with your API token (Workers AI:Edit): 28+ models discovered live from models.dev, the 8 paid-only models flagged, and a Neurons/day allowance row in magpie quota.
summary.zh: 用你的 Cloudflare API Token（Workers AI:Edit 权限）登录 Workers AI：28+ 模型经 models.dev 实时发现，付费专属模型自动标注，magpie quota 显示每日 Neurons 免费额度。

summary.en: River (river.ai) pay-as-you-go inference with your API key: per-account models from /v1/models, documented reasoning efforts and live prices from River's public pricing endpoint.
summary.zh: 用你的 API key 接入 River (river.ai) 按量计费推理：按账号从 /v1/models 列出模型，带官方推理档位与实时价格。

summary.en: Explore Google Trends, website traffic, domain rating (DR), keyword suggestions, SERPs, backlinks, and ads statistics for market, keyword, and competitor research.
summary.zh: 查询 Google 趋势、网站流量、域名权重（DR）、关键词建议、SERP、外链和广告统计，辅助市场、关键词与竞品研究。

summary.en: Tencent Cloud OrcaTerm (遨驰终端) AI assistant models — DeepSeek, Hunyuan, GLM, Kimi — on the account's monthly question allowance. Unofficial; the README sets out the terms.
summary.zh: 用腾讯云遨驰终端（OrcaTerm）AI 助手的模型——DeepSeek、混元、GLM、Kimi——走账号每月问答额度。非官方，条款风险见 README。

summary.en: Window warmup (formerly Scheduled Messages): warm up a subscription's 5-hour or weekly quota / usage window ahead of time with a keep-alive (keep alive) message. It sends one fixed short message ("hi", max_tokens 16) to a provider, account and model you pick, on a schedule: right after its rate limit window resets, daily at set times or every few hours. Each send uses that provider's quota. Runs a local service on 127.0.0.1 that only calls magpie's own gateway; only its own page gets the token.
summary.zh: 窗口预热（原「定时消息」）：提前开启订阅的 5 小时或每周额度窗口，给额度保活。给指定的供应商、账号和模型发一条固定短消息（"hi"，max_tokens 16），可在窗口重置后、每天定时或每隔几小时发送。每次发送都会消耗该供应商的额度（配额）。在本机 127.0.0.1 跑一个本地服务，只调用 magpie 自己的网关；令牌只交给自己的页面。

summary.en: Unofficial AStudio (iFLYTEK Astron Studio desktop): reuse the desktop sign-in to serve its Responses model gateway, with the live model catalog, daily login-points check-in and points balance. Desktop discovery runs on Windows (registry lookup), with a paste-token fallback. Differs from Providers Hub's hub-astudio, which signs in on a local page (SMS, password or WeChat QR) and calls chat/completions; on one account both share the same daily points pool.
summary.zh: 非官方 AStudio（科大讯飞 Astron Studio 桌面端）：复用桌面端登录态接入其模型网关，含实时模型目录、每日登录积分签到与积分余额。桌面端发现仅 Windows（注册表定位），另有粘贴凭据方式。与 Providers Hub 的 hub-astudio 不同：那边在本地登录页用短信、密码或微信扫码登录，走 chat/completions；同一账号两边共用一个每日积分池。

summary.en: Unofficial Agnes Code desktop: reuse the desktop sign-in for its OpenAI-compatible gateway, with the live model catalog, daily credit check-in and points balance. Desktop decryption is Windows-only; a paste-token method covers the rest. Differs from opencode-agnes-auth (`agnes`), which signs in to Agnes AI international in Chrome and meters that product's plans and USD balance: this one serves the Agnes Code desktop product and its daily credits.
summary.zh: 非官方 Agnes Code 桌面端：复用桌面端登录态接入其 OpenAI 兼容网关，含实时模型目录、每日积分签到与余额显示。桌面端解密仅限 Windows，其余平台用粘贴 accessToken。与 opencode-agnes-auth（`agnes`）不同：那边在 Chrome 里登录 Agnes AI 国际版、显示该产品的套餐与美元余额；本包服务 Agnes Code 桌面端产品与它的每日积分。

summary.en: Recall OpenViking context before model requests and optionally capture completed conversations. Reuses your existing OpenViking configuration; capture is off by default. Maintained by the OpenViking project.
summary.zh: 在模型请求前召回 OpenViking 上下文，并按需采集完整对话。复用现有 OpenViking 配置；采集默认关闭。由 OpenViking 项目维护。

summary.en: A bridge between Magpie agents and locally hosted ComfyUI models, exposing native workflows, model resources and generated images through Magpie's tools MCP endpoint.
summary.zh: 连接 Magpie Agent 与本地 ComfyUI 模型的桥接层，通过 Magpie 工具 MCP 入口提供原生工作流、模型资源和生成图片。

summary.en: Connect PinK to Magpie's models from the Agents page and track gateway usage and cost. Disconnecting restores the managed configuration.
summary.zh: 在 Agent 页面连接 PinK，使用 Magpie 中配置的模型并查看调用用量与费用；断开时恢复插件管理的配置。

summary.en: WispTerm on magpie's Agents page: pick one of magpie's models for its Agent, switch reasoning effort with /effort, and switch it off to put its config back. Needs WispTerm 1.46.1 or later.
summary.zh: 把 WispTerm 加到 magpie 的 Agent 页：给它的 Agent 选 magpie 的模型，用 /effort 切换思考强度，关掉即恢复原来的配置。需要 WispTerm 1.46.1 或更新版本。

summary.en: CiteBox on magpie's Agents page: pick one of magpie's models for its text AI, set reasoning effort in Settings, and switch it off to put its config back. Needs CiteBox 0.38.0 or later.
summary.zh: 把 CiteBox 加到 magpie 的 Agent 页：给它的文本 AI 选 magpie 的模型，在设置里调整思考强度，关掉即恢复原来的配置。需要 CiteBox 0.38.0 或更新版本。

summary.en: Wisp Science on magpie's Agents page: pick one of magpie's models, set reasoning effort in the composer, and switch it off to put its config back. Needs Wisp Science 1.23.0 or later.
summary.zh: 把 Wisp Science 加到 magpie 的 Agent 页：选择 magpie 的模型，在输入框里设置思考强度，关掉即恢复原来的配置。需要 Wisp Science 1.23.0 或更新版本。

summary.en: Use Amazon Bedrock Claude and GPT models with your AWS CLI profile, including SSO / IAM Identity Center. SigV4 authentication; no Bedrock API key needed.
summary.zh: 使用 AWS CLI 配置（支持 SSO / IAM Identity Center）接入 Amazon Bedrock 的 Claude 和 GPT 模型，通过 SigV4 签名，无需 Bedrock API 密钥。

summary.en: Third-party Magpie adapter for dsh-providers-hub (by JetLi): five providers, each a separate channel you can sign in to, meter and switch off on its own — AStudio (iFlytek), Accio (Alibaba), LobsterAI (Youdao), MagiCrew (letsmagic.cn / magicrew.ai). Channels that already exist in the registry are not shipped. Runs without DSH. Its AStudio signs in on a local page (SMS, password or WeChat QR, no desktop app needed) and calls chat/completions; the standalone AStudio plugin (astudio) reuses the desktop sign-in and calls Responses. On one account both share the same daily points pool.
summary.zh: dsh-providers-hub（作者 JetLi）的第三方适配：五条供应商（每渠道一条，可各自登录/看额度/单独关闭）——AStudio（讯飞）、Accio（阿里）、LobsterAI（有道）、超级麦吉/MagiCrew（letsmagic.cn / magicrew.ai）。与社区 registry 已有插件重叠的渠道不随包提供。不依赖 DSH 运行。其中 AStudio 在本地登录页用短信、密码或微信扫码登录（不需要桌面端），走 chat/completions；独立的 AStudio 插件（astudio）复用桌面端登录态，走 Responses。同一账号两边共用一个每日积分池。

summary.en: Use your terminal Agent CLIs right inside magpie, by chat. Runs a local service on 127.0.0.1 that starts when the page opens and stops with magpie; only its own page gets the token. First install ~46 MB; Claude Code isn't bundled, so install the `claude` CLI yourself.
summary.zh: 把终端里的 Agent CLI 搬进 magpie 窗口，直接对话使用。会在本机 127.0.0.1 跑一个后台服务，打开页面才启动，随 magpie 退出；令牌只交给自己的页面。首次安装约 46 MB；不自带 Claude Code，要用请自己装 `claude` CLI。
